profiles.name: READ_ONLY
profiles.purpose: Evidence collection and analysis without mutation.
constraints: Scope must be explicit.
Read-only VCS evidence is allowed only when relevant to the authorized scope.
External or consequential actions remain prohibited.

profiles.name: DOCS_WRITE
profiles.purpose: Approved scoped documentation and derived-artifact changes inside established authority.
constraints: Profile selection does not override risk classification.
Markdown or documentation targets do not make framework, architecture, or global-constraint semantic changes non-consequential.
Authority semantic changes require ELEVATED_CHANGE and explicit Human Authority.
Protected consequential areas require separate elevation and approval.
Permission is limited to exact approved paths and expires with the slice.

profiles.name: CODE_WRITE_SCOPED
profiles.purpose: Bounded approved implementation inside established authority.
constraints: Implementation must follow an approved bounded plan.
No dependency, package, ProjectSettings, assembly-topology, permission, or authority change is authorized.
Scope expansion requires a new review, risk classification, approval, and permission.
Permission is limited to exact approved paths and expires with the slice.

profiles.name: VALIDATE
profiles.purpose: Execute explicitly authorized validation and collect evidence.
constraints: Validation scope and side effects must be explicit.
This profile does not authorize implementation repair.
This profile does not authorize package or ProjectSettings mutation.
Executed and not-executed checks must be distinguished.
Evidence generation is allowed only at task-authorized locations.

profiles.name: ELEVATED_CHANGE
profiles.purpose: Approved R3 mutation of a consequential or elevated boundary.
constraints: Profile availability alone is not approval.
Explicit Human Authority must identify the exact elevated boundary, targets, conditions, and validation.
Permission does not include adjacent R3 actions or human-controlled publication unless separately approved.
Permission expires at the approved slice boundary.
